messages:
Rae: Opening thread for a 'cost-lens' console feature request from two customers. They want an at-a-glance matrix tying routes, model variants, and dollars + the ability to pull sampled traces and CSV exports. Goal: make model-switch recommendations obvious.
Cam: From infra: we should prefer rolled-up aggregates by minute(route,model,region) and keep sampled raw spans small. Raw tokens per-request logs will explode if not gated.
Jordan: UX sketch: matrix rows = model-variant, cols = route; cell color = estimated $/1k tokens. Hover shows 7d delta and "try model-x" recommendation with estimated monthly savings. Drill -> sampled traces and error buckets.
Len: Tracing hook idea: emit a micro-span per request with tags {model, route, token_count, quant_variant, batch_size}. Default sample 0.5% for hosted. Console setting to raise sample per-org.
Priya: CS: enterprise asks: CSV export + S3 export, PII masking rules, and an "impact" column that shows predicted monthly cost delta if they change model routing. They also want an RFC for data retention.
Rae: MVP scope proposal: (1) cost-lens matrix UI with filters (time, region, tier), (2) per-org CSV export (30d), (3) sampled trace link + minimal span tags + sampling toggle, (4) error grouping by class. Enterprise: S3 export + opt-in richer spans behind KMS.
Cam: Ops guardrails: ingestion overhead must be <5% during canary. Implement fallback: stop raw span export and rely on precomputed aggregates for heavy orgs. All spans scrub free-text by default.
Jordan: Launch acceptance draft: functional = matrix + CSV + trace links; reliability = p95 latency regression <2% in canary; cost = ingest delta <5% vs baseline; privacy = prompt/user fields removed unless enterprise opt-in.
Len: Quick infra checklist:
- span_schema = model, route, tokens, batch, quant_variant
- sampling_default = 0.005 (hosted)
- fallback = aggregate_per_minute(route, model)
- per-org sample toggle + soft quota
Priya: I'll gather two enterprise requirements re: masking and export formats and confirm expected retention windows.
Rae: Rollout plan: canary to 10% non-enterprise for 10 days, monitor p95/ingest/error, ramp to 50% for 7 days if stable, then full. CanaryBot: canary started at 6141592045 :rocket:
Cam: I'll provide an ingestion cost estimate and fallback thresholds by EOD tomorrow. Len + Jordan will draft infra/telemetry specs.
Rae: Thanks. Follow-up scheduled in #product next Monday to lock timeline and acceptance tests. /end
